_doc: News-driven projection overrides (v3 T3, PROGRESS.md Market 1 v3). Append-only log; never delete entries — expired ones are history, and the layer's live performance is scored from this file later. Schema per entry: player (BP display name), added (UTC ISO), game_date (ET date the override targets, or null for until-cleared), status (out|questionable|in), minutes_est (number|null), minutes_range ([lo,hi]|null), source (short name), url, quote (short supporting quote), author (news-watch|owner), superseded_by (index|null).

entries.source: ESPN WNBA injuries API + ESPN news API
entries.quote: Plum (leg, physical results) is questionable for Monday's matchup with the Sky. Traded LAS->PHO on 2026-08-02; her last game played was 2026-06-21 (panel confirms zero appearances since), so tonight would be a debut off a six-week absence. True belief if she plays is the 16-30 range (ramp); minutes_est deliberately set at the TOP of that range because it is the assumption least favourable to a news-driven bet - the base model's 34-min state produced assists-over EV +19.7%, and a 20-24 min estimate would flip the same market to a >10% under. The situation is too uncertain to bet either way, so the override removes the stale-role over without manufacturing an under.
entries.author: news-watch

entries.quote: 'Kelsey Plum set for return, Mercury debut after crazy 48 hours' (published 2026-08-04T00:38Z) - introduced as a Mercury player Monday evening in Chicago after the LAS->PHO trade. Supersedes the 2026-08-03 questionable entry: she is returning, but the panel's last Plum game is 2026-06-21, so her base state is a stale ~34-min LA role. Until PHO games with her in them enter the panel, hold a ramp estimate at the TOP of the 16-30 range - the assumption least favourable to a news-driven bet, so this removes a stale-role over without manufacturing an under. No PHO props are on the 8/4-8/5 sheet, so this is currently inert; game_date null so it applies whenever her props first post. Re-judge once she has PHO appearances in the panel.
entries.author: news-watch

entries.source: ESPN box score (PHO@CHI 2026-08-03) + ESPN news API + ESPN WNBA injuries API
entries.quote: Plum's Mercury debut (2026-08-03, W 106-101 at Chicago): 21 MIN, 20 PTS (6-10 FG, 3-5 3PT), 4 AST, +12. Supersedes entry 2's 28, which was a guess made before she played. Estimate 25 for game two of the stint: a genuine central estimate of the ramp between the 21 measured minutes and her pre-absence norm (~30+), not a number picked to reach a bet. Sensitivity, recorded because it is the whole story here: at <=23 min the model prices a threes-UNDER 1.5 and a points-UNDER 16.5; at >=28 it prices a points-OVER 16.5. Every Plum edge on this sheet is an artifact of the minutes assumption, so no Plum bet is taken this firing. The under branch is the worse of the two: wehoop has not published the 08-03 box scores, so the panel still carries her pre-trade LAS per-minute form and is blind to the debut's 5 three-point attempts in 21 minutes - fresh evidence that cuts directly against a threes-under.
entries.author: news-watch

entries.quote: CLEARED: Mabrey (neck, Day-To-Day, return_date 2026-08-04) dropped from BOTH the league injury report and the TOR@GSV per-event report between the 16:34Z and 21:35Z snapshots, while the Out entries on the same two reports (Sykes, Rupert) persisted - so this is a genuine clearance, not a feed dropout. No minutes injected: the panel already carries her full role (28-32 min in each of her last six games through 7/30), so the base state needs no correction. Inert by design - it removes the Day-To-Day availability flag from her 8/4 points-over pick without moving the price.

entries.quote: UPDATED: Taylor (CHI, groin) upgraded Out -> Day-To-Day between the 21:35Z and 22:36Z snapshots, return_date 2026-08-05 (Chicago's next game). A genuine upgrade, not a feed dropout - she stayed on the report with a changed status while eight other rows left it. No minutes injected deliberately: the panel carries her full role (26/31/30 min on 7/22, 7/30, 8/1) and any haircut for a groin return would be a guess, and a guess in the direction that manufactures unders - the Plum lesson from entry 3. She has no prop on the current sheet, so the entry is archival plus the Day-To-Day flag the picks table now shows. Sensitivity if a Taylor prop posts before tip: at the panel's ~30 min her lines price near fair; a real return-limited 18-22 min would cheapen unders, so any Taylor edge that appears is an artifact of the minutes assumption and is not bettable without a lineup confirmation.
entries.author: news-watch

entries.quote: DOWNGRADE the status diff does not show: Stevens (CHI, Personal) stayed Out across 21:35Z -> 22:36Z, but her return_date moved 2026-08-05 -> 2026-08-08, i.e. she is now ruled out of Chicago's 8/5 game rather than a candidate to return for it. Recorded because the printed diff only reports status transitions and would miss this. Inert on price by design: she has already missed 7/30 and 8/1 (nan minutes in the panel) after a 28-33 min starter role through 7/22, so the panel's recent CHI state is already Stevens-less - her continued absence is the status quo, and no minutes are injected into Cardoso or Reese, whose 8/5 props are on the sheet. No Stevens prop is quoted.

entries.quote: CLEARED, and this entry stands for the whole batch of eight that cleared at 22:36Z: Westbeld (CHI), Alissa Pili, Tonie Morgan, Monique Akoa Makani (LAS), Anneli Maley (NYL), Kara Dunn, Shay Ciezki (PHO), Darianna Littlepage-Buggs (WAS). Every one of them carried return_date 2026-08-05 and every one dropped in the same refresh, while rows with later return dates persisted and two of them (Stevens, Mair) were pushed 08-05 -> 08-08 - the signature of ESPN rolling the report forward to the 8/5 slate, so read it as 'expected available 8/5', not as eight simultaneous medical clearances. No minutes injected for any of the eight and none has a prop on the sheet: all are deep-bench or DNP-heavy (Westbeld 8-11 min in her three appearances since 6/20; Pili 2-12 min; Maley 11-14 min in two July games), so the panel's small roles for them need no correction and there is nothing here to score. Grouped rather than filed eight times because the content, and the nil price effect, is identical; named in full so the archive keeps each one.

entries.quote: ESPN league injury report, 2026-08-05 16:35Z: NEW entry - "Clark (back) is questionable for Wednesday against the Wizards" (Dallas Wings, status Day-To-Day, type Back, return date 2026-08-05). A healthy -> questionable downgrade for tonight's DAL@WAS (event 2704). No minutes estimate is attached: Clark has zero rows in projections.csv, so nothing is priced off her and inventing a number would be guessing without a bet to discipline it. Recorded because the protocol treats status downgrades as override entries and the archive is the future training set. Note for the reader, not modelled: the sheet's DAL pick is Jessica Shepard rebounds over 11.5 - a Clark absence would if anything help that side, and the override layer adjusts only the named player's minutes, so no adjustment is made in either direction.
